card: Enables the clang-tidy check bugprone-signed-char-misuse and adjusts a few lines of code to satisfy the new rule. This is intended to help developers catch unintended sign extension bugs such as out-of-bounds memory accesses. The author cites a historical out-of-bounds read bug resolved in commit 43a33e51 as evidence of value.
evidence: Author states that enabling this check 'can help to prevent out-of-bounds reads such as the one removed in 43a33e513c4044dc01d92e77da76f2e98faaedb5, or prevent other bugs' (PR description).
problem: Unintended sign extension of signed char types can cause bugs such as out-of-bounds array reads, but clang-tidy does not currently check for this pattern in the codebase.

risk.why: Enabling a static analysis check with minimal code adjustments carries virtually no operational risk.

scope_notes: Very small patch modifying clang-tidy configuration and a few lines of C++ code to satisfy the linter.
summary: Enables the clang-tidy check bugprone-signed-char-misuse. Also adjusts a small number of existing code locations using signed characters to satisfy the linter check.
uncertainties: Exact files and code locations being modified cannot be seen because the diff was omitted.
